about_the_game:
Welcome to New Eastbrook

In this city, no closet is without skeletons. You are James Arnold, a rookie detective assigned to investigate the assassination of New Eastbrook's mayor, Casey Ward, as well as the seemingly-connected deaths of police officers throughout the year of 2022. Every lead drags you deeper into a web of mob power, crooked cops, and corruption that will not yield. Savour a fully-voiced tumultuous detective story involving constant emotional, rarely clear-cut decisions.

Investigate and Interrogate

  • Search crime scenes for hidden evidence, from bloody weapons left behind to mobile phones of victims containing suspicious phone records.

  • Piece together the evidence obtained to build an idea of what happened in each crime scene, the motives behind the crime, and who committed it.

  • Interrogate suspects using a mix of sympathy, stone-cold neutrality, and raw aggression as needed to draw out the truth.

  • No choice is ever clean; the paths you take in each case will reveal what type of detective you choose to be.

Survive the Streets

  • Engage in a gritty, melee-only combat using a vast array of weapons, from baseball bats to meat cleavers.

  • Fight alone against the worst of the city, from thugs in a back alley to mob enforcers in a warehouse.

  • Use a combination of timing, positioning, and bravery to defeat enemies in encounters where the odds are never in your favour.

Build a Life Worth Fighting For

  • Customize your character, visit the various barbers and clothing shops to change your look.

  • Buy houses across the city and customize their interior furniture to your liking.

  • Tune your ride: paint jobs, seat colours, interiors, and tires; as well as a spoiler and a supercharger (which also tunes your car's engine).

  • Invest in businesses that return a steady income to keep the lifestyle going.

Explore

  • Delve into a large open world where you can also visit restaurants to refuel and pawn shops to sell whatever junk you collect along the way of your adventures.

  • Participate in side activities such as backyard brawls.

  • Processor: Intel i5-4460 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 960 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

short_description: Freshly-graduated detective James Arnold is sent on a mission to investigate the death of the mayor of New Eastbrook, a little-known city where corruption is tradition. Investigate crime scenes, interrogate suspects, and fight criminals in a city where every choice pulls you deeper into the shadows.
